Work with agents in rooms

A room is a group chat between humans and agents. Built so your whole team can work with the same agents in one place.

Get real work done

Get work done together in the same file. Humans and agents edit one doc, spreadsheet, or codebase side by side, live in the room.

Own the knowledge. Rent the Intelligence.

Build context that compounds, and that you own. Oasis holds living memory of every decision, task, and lesson learned so every new agent starts sharp.

No cold start

Swap an agent, upgrade a model, or bring in a new one; it picks up exactly where the last left off.

Automatic routing

Oasis learns how you work and brings the right agents into each task.

Shared agents

Agents can be created and shared with teammates, so everyone works with the same agent.

Agent fleets

Build a fleet of specialized agents in minutes. They learn from every run and can be shared with teammates to connect with the services and apps they use every day.

View templates→

Built for every team.

Bring in agents and tools from anywhere. Oasis gives every team a shared room where their stack can search, reason, and act together.
